title: EtherTales
tagline: Empowering Imagination on the Blockchain: Where Stories Become NFT Adventures
description: EtherTales leverages the power of NFTs and blockchain technology to transform digital stories into unique, verifiable assets that users can own and trade. Arbitrum Stylus enhances this experience by providing a scalable and efficient environment for developing and deploying our platform, ensuring a seamless and decentralized storytelling experience for users worldwide.
how_its_made:
Integration Complexity: Integrating the ERC-721 and ERC-20 contracts with the Arbitrum Stylus environment posed challenges due to differences in syntax and functionality. It required careful adaptation and debugging.

Gas Estimation Errors: Gas estimation errors occurred during deployment, particularly on Arbitrum Sepolia. This required investigation into the specific environment configurations and EVM versions to ensure compatibility.

Frontend and Contract Mismatch: Issues arose when interacting with the contract on the frontend, potentially due to mismatches in function calls or parameter types. Synchronizing the frontend and contract interactions required meticulous troubleshooting.
